bio.text: Eric Morrison has represented the 27th District in the Delaware House of Representatives since 2020.
Morrison grew up in Bridgeville and graduated from the University of Delaware Honors Program in 1996 with an English major.
Morrison worked for six years as a full-time educator, then for 13 years in state Medicaid, Medicare and other health programs, and now works as a technical writer.
